        ORG   26000
;MANDELBROT FRACTAL ENCODER
;Presented at Noumenon demo, ENLIGHT'97
;(C) ALK/Stars of Keladan
;Samara,May-August/1997
        ENT
        DI
        CALL  makesc
        CALL  calcu
        LD    IY,#5c3a
        LD    HL,10072
        EXX
        EI
        RET
calcu   LD    HL,begy
        LD    DE,imag
        LDI
        LDI
        LDI
        LDI
        LD    HL,#5800
        LD    (adout+1),HL
        LD    B,24
lcolo   PUSH  BC
        LD    HL,begx
        LD    DE,real
        LDI
        LDI
        LDI
        LDI
        LD    B,32
lstrf   PUSH  BC
        CALL  frcalc
adout   LD    HL,0
        LD    (HL),B
        INC   HL
        LD    (adout+1),HL
        LD    IX,stepx
        LD    DE,real
        PUSH  DE
        POP   IY
        CALL  summar
        POP   BC
        DJNZ  lstrf
        LD    IX,stepy
        LD    DE,imag
        PUSH  DE
        POP   IY
        CALL  summar
        POP   BC
        DJNZ  lcolo
        RET
frcalc  XOR   A
        LD    H,A
        LD    L,A
        LD    (kwar),HL
        LD    (arez),HL
        LD    (kwar+2),HL
        LD    (arez+2),HL
        LD    (kwaim),HL
        LD    (aimez),HL
        LD    (kwaim+2),HL
        LD    (aimez+2),HL
        LD    B,15
;MAY BE A 1-255 (MORE DIGIT - MORE SLOW,
;BUT BETTER!)
lcalf   PUSH  BC
        LD    IX,kwar
        LD    IY,kwaim
        LD    DE,rex
        CALL  raznost
        LD    IX,arez
        LD    IY,aimez
        LD    DE,imy
        PUSH  DE
        CALL  twomult
        POP   HL
        SLA   (HL)
        INC   HL
        RL    (HL)
        INC   HL
        RL    (HL)
        LD    IX,real
        LD    IY,rex
        LD    DE,arez
        CALL  summar
        LD    IX,imag
        LD    IY,imy
        LD    DE,aimez
        CALL  summar
        LD    IY,arez
        LD    DE,kwar
        CALL  kwadra
        JP    C,excalf
        LD    IY,aimez
        LD    DE,kwaim
        CALL  kwadra
        JP    C,excalf
        LD    IX,kwar
        LD    IY,kwaim
        LD    DE,krite
        CALL  summar
        JP    C,excalf
        LD    A,(krite+2)
        OR    A
        JP    NZ,excalf
        LD    A,(krite+1)
        CP    #80
        JP    NC,excalf
        POP   BC
        DJNZ  lcalf
        RET
excalf  POP   BC
        RET
;VARIABLES:
arez    DEFW  0,0
aimez   DEFW  0,0
rex     DEFW  0,0
imy     DEFW  0,0
kwar    DEFW  0,0
kwaim   DEFW  0,0
real    DEFW  0,0
imag    DEFW  0,0
krite   DEFW  0,0
;--------
;LOCATION CONSTANTS;
stepx   DEFB  #14,0,0,0
stepy   DEFB  #18,0,0,0
begy    DEFB  #08,1,0,#FF
begx    DEFB  #E0,1,0,#FF
;--------
;SOMETHERE INSIDE
;stepx   DB    #01,0,0,0
;stepy   DB    #01,0,0,0
;begy    DB    #28,0,0,#FF
;begx    DB    #80,1,0,#FF
;--------
;CLASSIC
;stepx   DB    #14,0,0,0
;stepy   DB    #18,0,0,0
;begy    DB    #08,1,0,#FF
;begx    DB    #E0,1,0,#FF
;--------
;ONE HALF - NOUMENON PACK
;stepx   DB    #14,0,0,0
;stepy   DB    #10,0,0,0
;begy    DB    #00,0,0,#00
;begx    DB    #E0,1,0,#FF

multi   LD    A,LX
        XOR   HX
        EX    AF,AF
        LD    A,B
        LD    B,24
        EXX
        LD    C,A
        XOR   A
        LD    (flex+1),A
        LD    LX,A
        LD    HX,A
        LD    LY,A
        LD    HY,A
        LD    B,A
        LD    E,A
        LD    D,A
        LD    L,A
        LD    H,A
        EXX
lpmul   SRL   C
        RR    H
        RR    L
        JP    NC,nadmu
        ADD   IX,DE
        EXX
        JP    NC,nn1
        INC   IY
nn1     ADD   IY,BC
        ADC   HL,DE
        EXX
        JP    NC,nadmu
        LD    A,#ff
        LD    (flex+1),A
nadmu   SLA   E
        RL    D
        EXX
        RL    C
        RL    B
        RL    E
        RL    D
        EXX
        DJNZ  lpmul
        PUSH  IY
        POP   HL
        LD    C,HX
        EX    AF,AF
        LD    HX,A
flex    LD    A,0
        RRCA
        RET   C
        EXX
        LD    A,H
        OR    L
        EXX
        RET   Z
        SCF
        RET
kwadra  PUSH  IY
        POP   IX
twomult PUSH  DE
        LD    E,(IX+0)
        LD    D,(IX+1)
        LD    B,(IX+2)
        LD    A,(IX+3)
        LD    LX,A
        LD    L,(IY+0)
        LD    H,(IY+1)
        LD    C,(IY+2)
        LD    A,(IY+3)
        LD    HX,A
        CALL  multi
        POP   DE
        EX    DE,HL
        LD    (HL),C
        INC   HL
        LD    (HL),E
        INC   HL
        LD    (HL),D
        INC   HL
        LD    A,HX
        LD    (HL),A
        RET
raznost LD    A,(IY+3)
        LD    (oldz+1),A
        CPL
        LD    (IY+3),A
        CALL  summar
oldz    LD    A,0
        LD    (IY+3),A
        RET
summar  LD    A,(IX+3)
        LD    C,A
        XOR   (IY+3)
        JP    NZ,raznz
        LD    A,C
        EX    AF,AF
        LD    C,(IX+0)
        LD    B,(IX+1)
        LD    L,(IY+0)
        LD    H,(IY+1)
        ADD   HL,BC
        LD    A,(IX+2)
        ADC   A,(IY+2)
exsum   EX    DE,HL
        LD    (HL),E
        INC   HL
        LD    (HL),D
        INC   HL
        LD    (HL),A
        INC   HL
        EX    AF,AF
        LD    (HL),A
        EX    AF,AF
        RET
raznz   PUSH  DE
        LD    E,(IX+0)
        LD    D,(IX+1)
        LD    C,(IX+2)
        LD    L,(IY+0)
        LD    H,(IY+1)
        LD    B,(IY+2)
        LD    A,C
        CP    B
        JP    C,ybo
        JP    NZ,xbo
        LD    A,D
        CP    H
        JP    C,ybo
        JP    NZ,xbo
        LD    A,E
        CP    L
        JP    C,ybo
xbo     EX    DE,HL
        LD    A,C
        LD    C,B
        LD    B,A
        LD    A,(IX+3)
        JP    nxxc
ybo     LD    A,(IY+3)
nxxc    EX    AF,AF
        OR    A
        SBC   HL,DE
        LD    A,B
        SBC   A,C
        POP   DE
        JP    exsum
makesc  LD    B,24
        LD    HL,#4000
        LD    A,#22
maker   PUSH  HL
        PUSH  BC
        LD    D,H
        LD    E,L
        INC   E
        LD    BC,#ff
        LD    (HL),A
        LDIR
        RRCA
        RRCA
        POP   BC
        POP   HL
        INC   H
        DJNZ  maker
        RET
